title: pm: issue-create.mjs sends issue_create labels through sendFleetWrite with no kind check, so --label pm:awaiting-merge still lands on a new issue
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

PR #31357 (#31253) applies the kind rule at the relay's CLI door (`fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`): no pm state label on a pull request, and no `pm:awaiting-merge` on an issue, matched case-insensitively. Its contract review (6717084424) found one script that still sends `issue_create` around it. `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs` takes free-form `--label` values and calls `sendFleetWrite` directly. It already runs `rewriteRetiredLaneLabels`, but it runs no kind check. So `issue-create.mjs --label pm:awaiting-merge` (any case) still puts a PR-only label on a new issue.

`close-cards.mjs` is not a gap: its `packCard` refuses any label plan that adds a label.

## Suggested shape

One `refuseKindLabels({ kind: KIND_ISSUE, add: labels })` call (exported by `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`) beside the existing `rewriteRetiredLaneLabels` in issue-create.mjs. It refuses before any write, with the rule quoted. Add one self-test case and one ablation. Tooling-only, `skip-changeset`.
